ordinary_MatMul_contract.fact: MatMul exposes accumulation_type only. It has no declared result-type field. Accumulation F32 does not mean an F32 output tensor.

infer_matmul requires matching numeric input logical dtypes and constructs the dense output using left.data_type(). infer_output_descriptions validates accumulation and calls that inference. BF16 x BF16 therefore infers BF16 output.

An explicit TensorDesc output in the public prepare overload is validated against complete inferred descriptors. It is not permission to override result dtype. Exact cold proposal/prepare and shape instantiation preserve this validation.

Concrete explicit Graph output specs must equal operation inference. Symbolic add_node may defer concrete inference, but specialization later checks inferred dtype/format/rank and dimensions, or full description equality. An explicit symbolic F32 spec cannot legitimately bypass the BF16 MatMul result contract.

The current cuBLAS path separately requires matching input/output dtype, uses one common element byte width for all three ports and one cudaDataType for every layout. Merely deleting the equality check would be incorrect for output strides/storage spans and C/D layout types. This provider also accepts only OperationKind::kMatMul, not the existing custom F32-score operation.

inspected_semantic_facts.fact: Draft input/carry/prior are per-request, concatenated request-major. Catchup groups [stash,pending] and [prior,carry] inside each request before flattening; target tokens similarly interleave [pending,freshdraft] per request, not all pendings followed by all drafts.
